chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The cutting is from the middle of the palm, and the thumb is not cut. And when the foot is cut, the heel is left and is not cut.

key_terms.الرِّجْلُ: the foot, referring to the limb cut in the legal ruling
key_terms.الْإِبْهَامُ: the thumb, which is excluded from cutting
key_terms.الْعَقِبُ: the heel, which is left intact
key_terms.الْقَطْعُ: the prescribed cutting in the legal punishment
key_terms.وَسَطِ الْكَفِّ: the middle of the palm, indicating the location of amputation

ai.seo_question: From where is the hand cut in the hadd punishment for theft according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the prescribed manner of amputation in the hadd for theft. It specifies the part of the hand to be cut and clarifies that certain parts, such as the thumb and the heel, are to be left intact.
